newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian silver slightly down at close, gold steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian silver slightly down at close, gold steady.

text.p: Silver prices opened higher on the back of an uptrend in the world market but demand resistance thereafter trimmed early gains towards the close, dealers said.
Silver was up by 75 rupees per kg on Tuesday but was down by 100 rupees during last week.
"Improved arrivals at the higher level also capped rally," one broker added.
Gold on the other hand opened higher but held steady at that level during the day amid limited activity.
Gold was up by 10 rupees per 10 grammes on Tuesday.
